نلتوي (form VIII)
# نَلْتَوِي (naltawī) /nal.ta.wiː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِلْتَوَى (iltawā)
# نَلْتَوِيَ (naltawiya) /nal.ta.wi.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِلْتَوَى (iltawā)
